applications.title: Neutral grounding
applications.text: The neutral of a transformer or generator is connected to ground through a Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR) to limit phase-to-ground fault currents in case of a line-to-ground fault.

applications.title: Dynamic braking
applications.text: Dynamic braking resistors are used for rheostatic braking of electric motors. The excess kinetic energy from braking or slowing down the load is dissipated on the resistors.

applications.title: Loadbanks
applications.text: Loadbanks load gensets or other power sources so they can be tested to ensure they deliver their rated power in actual loading conditions.

applications.title: Motor starting
applications.text: Start resistors are used with switch-starters or contactors for starting and speed regulating of AC slipring motors as well as DC motors — where electronic drives are inadequate due to severe operating conditions.

hrgs.name: HRGS
hrgs.summary: Protects the plant's entire electrical grid from catastrophic ground faults.
intro: Öz Direnç HRGS uses resistors to protect the plant's entire electrical grid from catastrophic ground faults.

The Öz Direnç High Resistance Grounding System (HRGS) is used in continuous-process industrial plants where a sudden electrical shutdown would cause massive financial losses, unsafe conditions, or damaged product.
It is installed in electrical substations between the neutral point of a transformer (or generator) and the earth ground.

loadbanks.name: Loadbanks
loadbanks.summary: Test gensets, UPS and battery systems at their rated power under real loading conditions.
intro: Loadbanks are resistors for loading gensets or other power sources so that they can be tested to ensure they can deliver their rated power in actual loading conditions.
list: Periodic exercising of stand-by engine gensets
Load optimization in prime power applications
Remove and prevent carbon build-up on piston heads

motor-starting-resistors.name: Motor starting resistors
motor-starting-resistors.summary: Rugged start resistors for AC slipring and DC motors in severe operating conditions.
intro: Our resistor units are widely used in motor control applications where electronic drive systems become inadequate due to severe operating conditions — heavy vibration, very high ambient temperatures, dust and humidity are the prime parameters of design.
Start resistors are used in conjunction with switch-starters or contactors for starting and speed regulating of AC slipring motors as well as DC motors.
Contrary to popular belief, starting resistors are still widely used in heavy industries.

neutral-grounding-resistors.name: Neutral grounding resistors
neutral-grounding-resistors.summary: Limit phase-to-ground fault currents to protect equipment and personnel.
intro: The neutral of the transformer or generator is connected to ground through a Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR) to limit phase-to-ground fault currents.
Resistance grounding may be either of two classes, high resistance or low resistance, distinguished by the magnitude of ground-fault current permitted to flow.
reasons: To reduce burning and melting effects in faulted electric equipment, such as switchgear, transformers, cables and machines.
To reduce mechanical stresses in circuits and apparatus.
To reduce electric-shock hazards to personnel.
To reduce the arc blast or flash hazard to personnel.
To secure control of transient overvoltages.

oil-cooled-starters.name: Oil-cooled starters
oil-cooled-starters.summary: Safely start large electric motors in harsh environments and under heavy starting loads.
intro: Oil-cooled starters (also called oil-immersed starters) are used in heavy industries, mining and agriculture to safely start massive electric motors that pull immense electrical current.
They are specifically chosen for harsh environments, heavy starting loads, or areas prone to severe voltage fluctuations.

dynamic-braking-resistors.name: Dynamic braking resistors
dynamic-braking-resistors.summary: Dissipate the kinetic energy of braking loads in cranes, centrifuges and similar machines.
intro: Dynamic braking resistors are used for rheostatic braking of electric motors. The excess kinetic energy resulting from braking or slowing down the load is dissipated on electrical resistors.
We design powerful braking resistors for centrifuges, cranes and similar applications where DBRs are required.
